    init(width: int, height: int) is

        self.height = height

    si

        let at = (y * width + x) * 3

        bytes[at] = colour.red
        bytes[at + 1] = colour.green
        bytes[at + 2] = colour.blue
    si

    let file = IO.File.create(path)

    let header =

    file.write(pixels, 0, pixels.count)
